current_intent.user_prompt:
find this session, and create an export for it.  " Lesson candidates from this session:

  1. PreCompact chain overwrite pattern [score: 7] — technical, architectural

  1. PreCompact overwrites the same handoff file on every compaction cycle, replacing n_1_transcript_path with the new session's
  link. The chain survives only one step back. Fix: store the full session_chain (oldest-first list of session IDs) in each handoff
  snapshot so it survives the overwrite.

    - Complexity: 2 — required reading across 3 files to trace the root cause
    - Pattern: 2 — will recur on every system using PreCompact + compaction
    - Impact: 2 — architectural: makes /recap functional vs. completely broken
    - Novelty: need CKS check (likely new)
  2. session_chain field makes handoff envelope self-contained [score: 6] — technical

  2. Adding session_chain: list[str] to build_resume_snapshot() and reading it first in walk_handoff_chain() decouples the chain
  traversal from the fragile n_1 link. The handoff file becomes the authoritative chain store instead of relying on transitive n_1
  links.
  3. Windows Path normalization breaks string comparison [score: 6] — technical

  3. Path("C:\\...") normalizes to WindowsPath('C:/Users/...') with forward slashes, but JSON strings preserve backslashes. Path()
  equality handles this correctly; string comparison does not. Found in _find_handoff_referencing.
  4. _claude_base() must check P: drive before Path.home() [score: 5] — technical

  4. On this system, .claude state lives on P: but Path.home() / ".claude" resolves to C:. Order of checks matters when the project
  drive is not the home drive.
  5. GitHub #40319 is still open [score: 3] — tooling

  5. Session resume silently drops 300k+ tokens of history. Unrelated to our chain work — it's a Claude Code binary regression in
  v2.1.85+. Not fixable externally, but worth knowing so the symptom isn't misdiagnosed.
